name: Cheshire Cat:Rasies
short_desc: Build site-specific AI agents with memory, plugins, and REST/WebSocket APIs.
author: cheshire-cat-ai
description: Cheshire Cat is a production-ready AI agent framework. Use it to power WordPress sites with domain-specific memory (Qdrant), plugins/tools, and local LLMs via Ollama. This package exposes the admin at /admin and the REST/WS APIs, with optional API key and JWT auth.

form_fields.label: Public host (for admin UI links)
form_fields.hint: Used by the admin portal. Set to your domain/FQDN if exposing via Traefik (e.g., ai.example.com).

form_fields.label: Public port
form_fields.hint: External port Cheshire Cat will be reachable on. Leave 1865 unless you have a conflict.

form_fields.label: Behind HTTPS proxy (Traefik/NGINX)
form_fields.hint: Enable if Cat is served via HTTPS in front (avoids redirect issues).

form_fields.label: CORS allowed origins
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated origins allowed to call the API (e.g., https://www.example.com). Use * for any.

form_fields.label: HTTP API key (locks REST API)
form_fields.hint: If set, REST endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <key>. Use JWT for browsers.

form_fields.label: JWT secret
form_fields.hint: Used to sign JWTs if you enable JWT auth.

form_fields.label: Disable dev auto-reload
form_fields.hint: Turn off file-watch reloads in production.

form_fields.label: Qdrant host (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave blank to use embedded local vector DB. Set if using external Qdrant container.
